author: Catherine Lucey
description: President Donald Trump endorsed Representative Andy Barr, one of the Republicans running to replace former Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell in Kentucky’s primary election later this month.
title: Trump Picks Barr Over Musk-Backed Rival in Kentucky Senate Race

description: Jen Gavito, Senior Advisor with the Cohen Group and former Acting Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for Near Eastern Affairs in the Biden administration, says the planned withdrawal of 5,000 US troops from Germany reflects both frustration with NATO allies and potentially personal tensions between President Trump and Berlin over criticism of the administration’s Iran strategy. She also warns it may be harder for the US to absorb the economic fallout from a prolonged shutdown of the Strait of Hormuz. She speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Gavito on Germany Pullback, NATO Tensions

description: Jessica Taylor, Senate and Governors Editor for the Cook Political Report, says the 2026 Senate map is "trending in Democrats' direction," citing the lingering Iran conflict and rising gas prices as political headwinds for Republicans. She flags candidate risks in key contests, warning Democrats' path in Maine could be complicated by a "risky" nominee with "baggage." In Texas, she says the race could shift depending on whether Republicans nominate John Cornyn or Ken Paxton, with Paxton seen as more vulnerable against Democrat James Talarico, though the seat remains GOP-favored. She speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Senate Trending Toward Dems in '26: Taylor

description: Representative Eugene Vindman (D-VA), a retired US Army officer and member of the House Armed Services Committee, says the administration “owes” Congress an explanation of its Iran strategy as the conflict nears the 60-day mark, warning the ceasefire is only a temporary pause. He disputes President Trump’s claims on munitions stockpiles and calls the administration’s approach to Ukraine and Russia “all wrong” and “chaos.” Vindman also blasts Republicans over the DHS shutdown, saying the prolonged standoff caused “more chaos, more cruelty, more pain.” He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: White House Owes Congress Iran Plan: Rep. Vindman

author: Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump argued that his economic agenda had delivered for older Americans and lowered their costs of living as he sought to rally their support before November’s midterm elections.
title: Trump Seeks to Woo Seniors by Touting Tax Law, Drug Cost Push

description: The US has ordered the drawdown of roughly 5,000 troops from Germany, following through on President Donald Trump’s threats to reduce the American military presence in the country. Cohen Group Senior Adviser Jen Gavito discusses the Pentagon's decision on "Balance of Power: Evening Edition."  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Orders Withdrawal of About 5,000 Troops From Germany

author: Amanda Albright
description: Columbia University’s credit outlook was revised to negative by Moody’s Ratings, which cited rising risks tied to the “federal environment for higher education.”
title: Columbia Risks Losing Top Credit Rating as Trump Slams Colleges

author: Jen Judson, Kate Sullivan
description: President Donald Trump plans to withdraw about 5,000 American troops from Germany, according to CBS News, making good on threats to reduce the US military presence in the country, as tensions escalate over the US and Israel’s war with Iran.
title: US Plans to Pull About 5,000 Troops From Germany, CBS Says

description: American Airlines resumed flights to Venezuela after a seven-year hiatus, as President Donald Trump pushes to restore commercial and diplomatic ties after ordering the capture of President Nicolas Maduro. Eric Martin reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: American Flight Heads to Caracas as Commercial Flights to Venezuela Resume

author: Sakura Murakami, Nguyen Dieu Tu Uyen, Cao Ban
description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Saturday will use a speech in Vietnam to lay out her vision for the Indo-Pacific, as she seeks to bolster economic and security ties across the region in a move that could counter an increasingly assertive China.
title: Japan’s Takaichi to Revamp Indo-Pacific Vision in Vietnam Speech

description: On today's episode, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec speak with Jayati Bharadwaj, TD Head of FX Strategy on FX and Jeff Mason, Bloomberg News White House Correspondent, about the latest on negotiations, and the latest announcement on tariffs being reimposed on EU carmakers. They also speak with Magna International CEO Swamy Kotagiri, and the CEO of Brooks Running Dan Sheridan. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Bemoans Iran Talks, Magna CEO Talks News Trump Tariffs | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 5/1/2026

author: Nathan R Dean
description: The Pact with US Neighbors Is Under Review Ahead of a July Deadline.
title: There’s More Trade Drama Ahead for US Deal With Mexico, Canada

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power,  Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss President Trump's stance on Iran as he considers the path forward on Iran and tells lawmakers that he doesn't need congressional approval for military operations in the region. On today's show, Director and senior adviser of the Middle East Program at the Center for Strategic and International Studies Mona Yacoubian, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, Partner at Brownstein Hyatt Farber Schreck and Republican Strategist Rosemary Becchi, and Republican Congressman from Florida Mike Haridopolos. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says 'Not Happy' on Iran, Touts Hormuz Closure | Balance of Power: Early Edition 5/1/2026

description: President Donald Trump says he will increase tariffs on cars and trucks from the European Union to 25%, claiming the bloc is not complying with a trade agreement. Tyler Kendall reports on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Plans 25% Tariff on European Autos

author: Iain Marlow
description: The US government issued a warning about the sanctions risk of paying tolls to Iran for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, which has been shut since the war against Tehran began.
title: US Warns Shippers of Possible Sanctions If They Pay Hormuz Tolls

author: Magdalena Del Valle, Mia Gindis
description: The Trump administration sanctioned three Iranian currency exchanges and a Chinese oil terminal on Friday, as the US adds to pressure on Tehran to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
title: US Sanctions Iranian Exchanges, China Terminal on Oil Purchases

author: Katherine Pennacchio, Gonzalo Soto
description: President Claudia Sheinbaum said she will announce on Monday a series of measures aimed at strengthening private investment in Mexico, centered on a “radical simplification” of bureaucratic procedures.
title: Sheinbaum to Announce Steps to Boost Mexico’s Private Investment

author: Nick Wadhams
description: President Donald Trump imposed new sanctions on top Cuban officials, the White House said, part of a months-long push by the administration to ramp up economic and security pressure on the island.
title: Trump Ramps Up Pressure on Cuba With Fresh Sanctions Push

author: Jorge Valero
description: The head of the European Parliament’s trade committee called President Donald Trump’s threat to boost tariffs on EU cars and trucks “unacceptable,” and criticized the US for being an unreliable partner.
title: EU Parliament Trade Chief Calls Trump Tariff Threat Unacceptable

author: Josh Wingrove, Kate Sullivan
description: US President Donald Trump indicated he plans to attend the Group of Seven leaders’ summit in France in June, even with the US at odds with key allies over the Iran war and trade.
title: Trump Says He Will ‘Probably’ Go to G-7 Summit in France

description: President Donald Trump says the federal government was still looking at a rescue plan for Spirit Airlines and would offer a final proposal soon during remarks with reporters at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Still Looking at Spirit, Will Give Final Proposal

author: Matthew Bristow
description: Colombia’s surprise decision to halt interest rate increases this week was intended to prevent upheaval, but may come at a cost, according to central bank co-director Mauricio Villamizar.
title: Surprise Colombian Rate Decision Helps Avoid Volatility, Central Banker Says

author: Josh Wingrove
description: President Donald Trump said the federal government was still looking at a rescue plan for Spirit Airlines and would offer a final proposal.
title: Trump Says Still Looking at Spirit, Final Proposal to Come

author: Michelle Kaske, Chris Dolmetsch
description: President Donald Trump’s administration is continuing its push to end New York City’s congestion pricing program by appealing a decision by a federal judge that allowed the tolling plan to proceed.
title: Trump Administration to Appeal Ruling on NYC Congestion Pricing

author: Josh Wingrove
description: President Donald Trump said he was raising tariffs on cars and trucks from the European Union to 25%, claiming that the bloc had failed to fully comply with a trade agreement negotiated with the US.
title: Trump Says US to Raise Tariff Rate on EU Cars, Trucks to 25%

author: Daniel Carvalho
description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro was hospitalized in Brasilia on Friday morning to undergo surgery on his right shoulder, his wife Michelle Bolsonaro said in a post on Instagram.
title: Brazil’s Bolsonaro Admitted to Hospital for Shoulder Surgery

author: Carolina Pulice
description: President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on Thursday announced a program to renegotiate household debt, his latest measure to support consumption as he seeks to bolster his popularity ahead of Brazil’s October election.
title: Lula Unveils Debt Relief Program Ahead of Elections

author: Rose Henderson
description: Abraham was studying in a synagogue in Golders Green, north London, on Wednesday morning when someone rushed in with a warning: lock the doors, an attacker is on the rampage. Just outside, two Jewish men had been stabbed. Police surrounded the assailant, and arrested him on suspicion of attempted murder. For the 40–year-old Israeli, a visit to friends became a reminder of how quickly a sense of normality can shatter, even far from home.
title: Anger and Fear Overwhelms London’s Golders Green After Antisemitic Attack

author: Jonathan Tamari
description: Trump is looking to buy more time to reach a deal, and most Republicans are glad to give it.
title: GOP Steers Clear on Iran as War Hits Key 60-Day Milestone

author: Erin Ailworth, Michael Hirtzer
description: American farmers are ignoring US Department of Agriculture surveys in the latest sign of distrust in government data.
title: American Farmers Shun USDA Surveys as Trust in Data Erodes

author: Amanda L. Gordon
description: The press release from Zohran Mamdani declaring New York City’s first pied-à-terre tax cited a $238 million penthouse in Midtown bought by one Ken Griffith.
title: New York’s Ultra-Rich Defend Citadel’s Griffin As Penthouse Dig Turns Personal

author: Irina Anghel
description: President Donald Trump’s tariffs have resulted in a sharp fall in UK exports to the US, turning British trade surpluses into deficits in a dramatic reversal of transatlantic trade dynamics, according to official data.
title: Trump’s US Tariffs Turn British Trade Surpluses Into Deficits

description:
US President Donald Trump has vowed to maintain a naval blockade on Iran, reiterating that the policy is depriving the Islamic Republic of much-needed oil revenue. West Texas Intermediate, the main US crude marker, rallied toward $111 a barrel on Thursday, while Brent, the global benchmark, topped $126.

Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei cast doubt on the prospects of a deal, vowing not to give up the Islamic Republic’s nuclear or missile technologies, and signaling Tehran would keep control of the Strait of Hormuz.

The American Automobile Association says in California, the average statewide price for regular gasoline rose to $6.01, the highest since October 2023. Skyrocketing pump prices are a major political risk for President Donald Trump’s White House, especially ahead of the midterm elections.

Bloomberg's Charlie Wells explains on "The Pulse with Francine Lacqua." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran War: The US States Where Gas Prices Are Surging Fastest Under Trump

author: Manuela Tobias
description: The libertarian president is stretching the boundaries of what voters will take.
title: Corruption Scandals Are Plaguing Argentina’s Milei

author: Alex Longley, Julian Lee
description: No region of the world produces more oil and gas than the countries straddling the Persian Gulf, and most of it needs to travel by tanker via the Strait of Hormuz.
title: How the Strait of Hormuz Has Become a Weapon of War

author: Rachel Schilke, Maeve Sheehey, Lillianna Byington, Zach C Cohen
description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-S.D.) and House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-La.) have settled into a routine to navigate difficult politics: Johnson tells his members yes and Thune tells the House no.
title: Mike Johnson and John Thune Play Good Cop, Bad Cop to Ease Chaos

author: Tracy Alloway, Joe Weisenthal
description: Eyck Freymann on the biggest flashpoint of them all.
title: How Taiwan Became the World's Most Perilous Geopolitical Chokepoint

author: Tracy Alloway, Joe Weisenthal
description: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has highlighted the potential for long-running theoretical chokepoints to turn into reality, with dramatic results for both geopolitics and the global economy. But the hypothetical scenario that policymakers have arguably been losing the most sleep over for decades is the prospect of a major conflict between China and Taiwan. So how likely is it, and what would such a conflict actually look like? On this episode, we speak with Eyck Freymann, author of the new
title: Odd Lots: How Taiwan Could Become a Global Chokepoint (Podcast)

author: Patrick Sykes, Eltaf Najafizada
description: US President Donald Trump vowed to maintain a naval blockade on Iran and was briefed by commanders on further military options, according to a report, underscoring the fragility of the ceasefire between the warring countries.
title: Trump Vows to Maintain Pressure on Iran Through Naval Blockade

description: Oil held its second weekly gain as US President Donald Trump said he was sticking with a naval blockade of Iranian ports. Oil has soared more than a quarter over the past two weeks as the deadlock in negotiations extends the near-total closure of the crucial waterway, which before the war carried about a fifth of the world’s crude. Bloomberg's Anthony di Paola reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Oil Holds Weekly Gain as Trump Sticks With Blockade

description: US President Donald Trump said he was sticking with a naval blockade of Iranian ports as concerns the vital Strait of Hormuz would not reopen anytime soon continue. “The blockade is incredible,” Trump told reporters at the White House. Bloomberg’s Stuart Livingstone-Wallace reports.
title: Trump Sticks With Blockade, Says It’s ‘Incredible’

description: Author Amitav Ghosh has built a global following with novels that draw on historical research. His latest is Ghost-Eye, and it’s deeply personal, as he discusses with Mishal Husain. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Why ‘India Has Lost Its Way’

author: Sabrina Nelson Garcinuno
description: The country’s child poverty rate is one of the highest in Europe — and it’s barely changed in 20 years. Will an ambitious bet on universal childcare make a difference?
title: Spain’s Booming Economy Fails to Help Its Poorest Children

author: Sabrina Nelson Garcinuno
description: España quiere invertir miles de millones para combatir la pobreza infantil y la exclusión social
title: El auge económico de España no ayuda a sus niños más pobres

author: Brendan Murray
description: The global economy is increasingly captive to two opposing forces.
title: Economic Crosscurrents Go Global as Energy Shock Meets AI Wave
